messages:
maria-ae: Quick heads up — NovaPay wants a short POC. Requirements: sustain 150 qps mixed chat+embeddings for 30m, average request ~512 tokens, 95p latency target <300ms for chat. They also want a burst headroom to 300 qps for 2 minutes. Need a runbook, expected cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated), and any security blockers. Can we run a smoke + stress tonight so we can share numbers tomorrow morning? @sam-se @jeff-ml :eyes:

sam-se: I can own the run tonight. Do we know model family they want? open-llama-70b or a smaller variant? That will change both latency and cost.

maria-ae: They said prefer an LLM comparable to gpt-3.5 turbo, but open to guidance. They care about predictable tail latencies more than raw peak throughput.

jeff-ml: For 512 tokens avg, open-llama-13b-quant should be fine for initial numbers. If they want 70b we need different hardware and costs jump ~3x. I can spin a dedicated pool with 4xA10 equivalent for tonight.

nina-sre: For SLO math: 150 qps sustained -> need to size request routing + queueing. With batching off for low tail, recommend 6 nodes (4 cores each) in dedicated pool as a starting point. If we allow batching with 50ms latency budget we can cut cost ~20%. I'll prepare queue sizing calc.

sam-se: Runbook draft: 
1) Smoke (5m): 10 qps single model to validate correctness.
2) Ramp (10m): linear to 150 qps.
3) Sustain (30m): hold 150 qps.
4) Burst (2m): step to 300 qps, observe autoscale/fallback.
5) Cooldown (10m).
Load invocation snippet (k6-ish):
```
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 30m --env MODEL=open-llama-13b --endpoint https://redwood.test/api/generate
```
I'll have a short script to capture 50/90/95/99 latencies.

olivia-sec: Two quick security flags from questionnaire: 1) data retention — prospect needs 30-day logs retention and can we confirm no training on customer data; 2) KMS integration for keys. Both are supported, but need to confirm for Dedicated deployment. I can write a one-page answer.

maria-ae: Great. Also pricing ask: they're asking hosted per-token vs dedicated reserved monthly order of magnitude. Can someone give a ballpark (low/high) so I can negotiate?

jeff-ml: Ballpark: hosted for this workload (open-llama-13b quant) ~ $0.015 - $0.03 / 1k tokens in our current price sheet considering burst. Dedicated instance sizing rough: 6 nodes -> equivalent ~$18k-$28k/month (committed discount reduces to $12k-$18k/mo). I'll prepare precise calc after tonight's run.

nina-sre: Ops note: for the burst to 300 qps we should pre-warm cache and ensure autoscaler has a warm spare. I'll set autoscale min=6, max=12, burst policy to spin one node ahead at step. Also enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts.

deploy-bot: load-test started on pool: novapay-quickbench-171640. Test id: lb-171640-01

sam-se: First smoke passed. No anomalous errors. Posting initial 95p after ramp (open-llama-13b-quant): 95p chat latency = 260ms, 99p = 400ms, embeddings 95p ~ 120ms. Logging to shared drive.

maria-ae: Awesome. Can you capture CPU/GPU utilization and token cost during sustain? I'll need numbers for the commercial.

jeff-ml: Captured. Sustained GPU util ~78%, avg token rate ~280k tokens/min, estimate hosted equivalent cost = ~$1,200/day at current per-token assumptions. Dedicated amortized lower after monthly commit.

olivia-sec: Security Qs: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and no-training flag set. I'll draft answers with references to compliance docs.

sam-se: Final note: one anomaly during burst — coldstart added ~120ms on first few requests until KV warmed. Nina — we should note mitigation (warm spare + prefix caching).

nina-sre: Thanks. I'll add that to runbook and include rollback (fallback to a slightly cheaper variant) if 95p exceeds 350ms.

maria-ae: Perfect. I'll package runbook + costs + sec answers and send to NovaPay tomorrow AM. Thanks team :rocket:
